title: Qwen3.6-27B compact GDN Q/K scratch right-sizing

hardware.primary: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX / gfx1100 / HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 / PCI 0000:10:00.0 / sysfs card0 / 23.984375 GiB VRAM
hardware.safeguard: AMD Radeon Pro W7900 / gfx1100 / HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 / PCI 0000:0d:00.0 / sysfs card1 / 44.984375 GiB VRAM

implementation.problem: The promoted compact peer-GDN kernels index normalized Q/K as [token, k_head, 128], but session planning still reserved each plane as [token, v_head, 128]. Qwen3.6-27B has 16 K heads and 48 V heads.
implementation.change: Size prefill_query and prefill_key from the effective construction-time GDN mode. chain_compact_peer_wave32 owns K-head capacity; explicit chain_peer_wave32 retains V-head capacity; value remains per V head.
implementation.mode_change_guard: A peer route that needs more Q/K heads than the session allocation fails before launch and instructs the caller to construct a new session after setting HIPENGINE_GGUF_GDN_PREFILL_MODE.

profile_selection.protocol: Cache-only rocprofv3 eager decode, eight ROCTX-bounded timed steps after bulk prefill; 4K and 8K run serially on the XTX.
profile_selection.conclusion: The depth-dependent decode increase is full-attention traffic; weight traffic is depth-flat. Sole-T16/raw-sidecar alternatives and default INT8 KV were already rejected. The non-duplicative residency candidate was the compact GDN Q/K planning mismatch.

red_green.red: At 768 rows the current default exposed 18,874,368-byte normalized Q/K views; the compact ABI requires 6,291,456 bytes per plane.
red_green.green: The default owns 16-head Q/K, explicit chain_peer_wave32 owns 48-head Q/K, all simultaneously-live views remain disjoint, and post-allocation widening is rejected.

same_process_screen.protocol: One process per shape, forced old full-Q/K allocation followed by package candidate allocation; both execute the same compact kernels, one warmup plus three measured graph reset/replays.

protocol.hipengine: Clean selector-unset commit, package-default sole-T16 session, repeated token 9707, one discarded warmup plus three measured persistent reset/replays, bulk prefill, BF16 KV, HIP graph decode, 128 timed transitions, cached compiler artifacts.
protocol.whole_device_memory: 5 ms sysfs VRAM samples around the complete child process. Peak delta is peak minus pre-process baseline; this is the cross-engine memory scope.
protocol.command_template: env -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_GDN_PREFILL_MODE -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q4_T16_SELECTED_PREFILL_MODE -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_LINEAR_ATTN_CONV_PREFILL_MODE -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_PREFILL_ROUTER_SELECT_THREADS -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_PREFILL_DEVICE_METADATA HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-qwen36-27b-single-layout-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. /home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/bin/python scripts/qwen35_gguf_bench.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.6-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --quant gguf_q4_k_m --token-id 9707 --prompt-length <512|1024|4096|8192> --decode-tokens 128 --warmup-decode-tokens 1 --warmup-runs 1 --measured-runs 3 --persistent-session --force-bulk-prefill --bulk-prefill-attention-mode bulk --use-wmma-prefill --use-gemv-decode --graph-replay-decode --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-qwen36-27b-single-layout-hipcc-version.txt --require-cached-build --json <output>

growth_after.interpretation: Right-sizing removes 0.0953 GiB of avoidable short-to-mid-context growth. Above the 4096-row scratch cap, the remaining 4K-to-8K tracked growth is unchanged and remains expected BF16 full-attention KV plus small metadata, not a leak.

cross_engine.llamacpp_hip_memory_status: hipEngine remains below llama.cpp HIP whole-device peak at 512 and 1K, but above it at 4K and standardized 8K.
cross_engine.speed_status: All candidate throughput changes versus the frozen current hipEngine matrix are within 0.37%. The frozen 512/1K/4K prefill gates and 512/1K decode gates retain their prior pass/fail status; 4K decode remains open. The 8K llama.cpp rows are standardized llama-bench diagnostics, not context-matched server decode.

decision: Retain the exact route-shaped Q/K allocation. It removes 9.8125/21.25/107.375/107.375 MiB tracked at 512/1K/4K/8K and up to 108.254 MiB whole-device peak without a prefill, decode, token, NextN transaction, lifecycle, or W7900 regression. This is a real memory improvement, not cross-engine memory closure: the lower Vulkan floors still lead by 0.405/0.605/1.110/1.111 GiB.
